description: This customised Canadian Internet Use Survey table reports the proportion of households with internet access for Canada, Alberta and Alberta economic regions, metropolitan/agglomeration areas and metropolitan-influence zones. Breakdowns include household size/type, educational attainment, income quartile and ownership/rental tenure. The source identifies 2010 and lists an XLS spreadsheet. It explains a twelve-month survey reference period. This measures digital service access, not network speeds, link capacity or infrastructure topology. The broader survey content is described, but no claim is made that every survey variable appears in this custom table. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the original source identity and metadata. Source coverage is Alberta unless the described component explicitly includes Canada. The native licence field states Open Government Licence - Alberta. Access is labelled unrestricted but isopen is false; actual access and costs are unverified. No linked dataset, document, workbook, archive, installer, code or legal text was fetched. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown.
